## 6. lore — how free enters the room

**ANNA:** A note. how free enters the room

**ANNA:** Textbooks avoid this loanword, but everyday Coimbatore runs on it.

**ANNA:** ஃப்ரீயா விடுங்க
> let it go

**ANNA:** The verb root vidu means release, and the bare form stays strictly between peers.

**ANNA:** ஃப்ரீயா விடு
> leave it, casual

**ANNA:** Adding nga turns an English borrowing into quiet family deference.

**ANNA:** ஃப்ரீயா விடுங்க
> don't worry
